why: What ships, gear and standings UNLOCK or BOOST. The look-ahead planner (`next` > THE LONG VIEW) prices each chain: buy/train/earn the prerequisites, then the activity pays its own rate for the rest of the planning horizon. unlocks = activity ids (activity_catalog.json) that need this item/standing; boosts = {activity id: multiplier on that activity's ISK/hr}; requires = skills (name: level) to use it; est_cost = used only when the item is not on the scanned market. ALL numbers here are guesses marked guess=true: edit them or replace them with your own timed runs. Add new ships, gear and standings as the game grows.

ships.note: Gallente combat frigate: missions and ratting
tanky mining barge: bigger yield and ore hold than the Venture
bigger cargo hold for hauling and courier jobs

gear.note: each: ~25% more ore than Miner I
needed to scan down data and relic sites

standings.note: Level 2 security agents want about 1.0 standing; each Level 1 mission from this corp or its faction adds a little
